intro: On November 1–2, 2025, Biohackers World Conference & Expo took place at The Ritz-Carlton South Beach, bringing together over 1,200 participants from around the globe. The two-day experience featured more than 30 internationally recognized speakers and over 60 exhibitors showcasing the latest breakthroughs in science, wellness, and human performance. Leaders in biohacking, functional medicine, and longevity innovation gathered to connect, collaborate, and inspire. notionvc: a18ecf09-c271-4440-8357-96080eafba0e

blocks.text: Day One: Conference Explores Cutting-Edge Insights in Biohacking, Health Technology, and Human Performance

The conference was officially opened by [Mick Safron](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/mick-safron) and [Olia Chernova](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/olia-chernova), setting an inspiring tone for the sessions to follow. Emcee [Gabby Rosely](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/gabby-rosely) kicked off the conference with an engaging opening speech, inviting attendees to explore the latest advancements in biohacking, health technology, and performance enhancement.

The morning program featured a guest session about mycotoxins, inflammation and beyond by [Valérie Orsoni](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/valerie-orsoni), followed by two keynote presentations: [Philipp Samor von Holtzendorff-Fehling](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/philipp-samor-von-holtzendorff-fehling) shared insights on energy and consciousness, while [Clayton Thomas](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/clayton-thomas) addressed cellular health and detoxification strategies.

Midday sessions included talks from our Platinum partners [Dr. Nathan S. Bryan](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-nathan-bryan) and [Dr. Sogol Ash](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-sogol-ash), covering nitric oxide science and integrative approaches to hormonal health. Guest speakers [Flynn Skidmore](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/flynn-skidmore) and [Mitchell Raisman](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/mitchell-raisman) contributed perspectives on emotional resilience and neuroplasticity.

The afternoon resumed with a panel discussion moderated by [Dr. Cybil Bonhomme](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-cybil-bonhomme). Panelists [Jane Emma](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/jane-emma), [Kim Ressler](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/kim-ressler), and [Dr. Pradip Jamnadas](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-pradip-jamnadas) explored hydration, genetic testing, and fasting protocols, respectively.

The program continued with a sessions led by [Dr. Jin-Xiong She](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-jin-xiong-she) and [Linda Bamber-Olson](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/linda-bamber-olson), followed by a joint guest presentation from [Dr. David Karli](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/david-karli) and [Matt Dillon](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/matt-dillon). [Lea Llovio](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/lea-llovio) and [Susan Bratton](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/susan-bratton) closed the speaker lineup with sessions on regenerative therapies and intimacy wellness.

The day concluded with an exclusive screening of Your Second Fifty, featuring director [Laurent Goldstein](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/laurent-goldstein) and producer [Jennifer Miele](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/jennifer-miele).
Day Two Highlights: Expert Panels and Platinum Sessions Continue the Exploration of Health Innovation

The second day of the conference began with a performance by [Julietta](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/julietta), featuring a sound healing experience that set a calm and focused atmosphere for the day ahead.

Then emcee [Greg Dinkin](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/greg-dinkin) welcomed attendees with opening remarks, followed by a dedicated session that introduced key themes and transitions for the upcoming presentations.

The morning sessions included contributions from [Dr. Patrick K. Porter](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-patrick-k-porter), [David Korsunsky](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/david-korsunsky), presenting on the use of AI in biohacking, [Dr. Krishna Doniparthi](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/krishna-doniparthi), and [Leo Szymborski](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/13037). Each speaker addressed distinct aspects of health optimization and technological integration.

A panel discussion moderated by [Klaudia Balogh](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/klaudia-balogh) brought together [Philipp Samor von Holtzendorff-Fehling](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/philipp-samor-von-holtzendorff-fehling) and [Clayton Thomas](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/clayton-thomas) for a shared dialogue on advanced wellness strategies.

Following the lunch break, the afternoon resumed with a third panel discussion moderated by [Jenny Jones](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/jenny-jones). Panelists [Claire Martinsen](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/claire-martinsen), [Dr. Lisa Piper,](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-lisa-piper) [Matt Tjardes](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/matt-tjardes), and [Jonathan Oe](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/jonathan-oe) explored approaches to cellular and neurological health, frequency-based healing, PEMF and red light therapies, and innovations in active wear.

Guest speaker [Cru Von Holtzendorff-Fehling](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/cru-von-holtzendorff-fehling) led a dedicated session followed by sessions featuring [Paul Denslow](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/pual-denslow) and [Phil Wilson](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/phil-wilson).

The final panel discussion of the day, moderated by [Jason Pencek](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/jason-pencek), featured [Dr. Warren Brown](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/warren-brown), [Shah Haq](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/shah-haq), and [Taja Abitbol](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/taja-abitbol). The speakers explored what’s hype, what’s vital in biohacking, and where the future is heading.
The day concluded with a **$10k** **Grand Giveaway from our sponsors** featuring premium longevity products, supplements, and wellness gadgets from partners.
The Biohacking Expo Hall

The Expo Hall offered a dynamic showcase of innovation, featuring more than 60 exhibitors presenting technologies at the forefront of biohacking and preventive health. From personalized diagnostics and wearable devices to holistic wellness systems, participants explored how science and technology are reshaping approaches to performance, recovery, and longevity.

blocks.text: A Collaborative Network of Wellness Innovators

Beyond the title and platinum sponsors, gold, silver, bronze, and community sponsors played a crucial role in enriching the event: SNiP Nutrigenomics, GutID, CODE Health, The GoodFor Company, Relax Saunas, Oxygen Health Systems, Holistix International, Aristotle Education, Genova Connect, BioBloom, Pivot Business Group, LEORÊVER, The Power In Your Hands, Virya, ArcticCollagen, H-Wave, Opatra, Atlas Clinics, MyIVSpa, OxeFit, Medical Expo, Our Kitchen Our Life, Pulse PEMF, First Alternatives, Spring Sleep, BackBridge. Their contributions brought forward groundbreaking solutions in AI-driven health insights, microbiome testing, functional nutrition, and bioenergetic therapies.
Select partners sponsored the event’s grand giveaway and VIP bags, providing attendees with exclusive products ranging from functional foods to advanced recovery tools.
Join Us at the Next Biohackers World Conference & Expo in LA

As the event came to a close, attention turned to the [next Biohackers World Conference](https://www.biohackers.world/), scheduled to take place **in Los Angeles on March 28-29, 2026** . The forthcoming edition is expected to deliver new breakthroughs, expanded technology demonstrations, and deeper explorations into the science of longevity and human optimization.
